fact_text: The State Bank of Pakistan raised its policy rate by 100 basis points, from 10 percent to 11 percent.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: The State Bank of Pakistan's stated inflation target range is 5 to 7 percent, and the analyst expected inflation to stay above that range.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: April 2026 CPI inflation was forecast at about 11 percent, up from 7 percent in the prior month, and the analyst said the rate decision had been driven by this jump.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: The analyst linked the inflation jump to large government increases in petroleum prices, which pushed up the cost of essential goods and added cost pressure across companies.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: Higher policy rates lift deposit and TDR rates, so companies holding large cash balances earn more interest income, while companies with heavy debt pay more interest.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: The analyst said Pakistan Oilfields benefits from higher rates because its cash and short-term investments earn more, adding per-share earnings.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: The analyst said Attock Petroleum also gains from higher interest rates because of its cash holdings, which lift its per-share earnings.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: The analyst estimated that the rate rise adds about Rs 6 to 7 per share to Attock Refinery's earnings through interest on its cash balances alone.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: Pakistan State Oil is among the companies that lose from higher rates, because its large debt makes its interest cost rise with the policy rate, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: Sui Northern Gas Pipelines carries heavy debt, so the analyst expects higher policy rates to add to its finance costs.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: Sui Southern Gas, a gas marketing and transmission company, is among those with heavy debt that the analyst expects to be hurt by higher interest rates.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: Engro Holdings' telecom tower business grew from about 4,400 towers to about 15,000 after the Deodar acquisition was completed in 2025, which the analyst said makes it a growing tower operator.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: The Deodar acquisition, which Engro completed in 2025, was valued at roughly USD 500 to 600 million, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: Engro Holdings' consolidated revenue rose from about Rs 100 billion to about Rs 131 billion in the first quarter, and gross margins also improved.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: Engro's first-quarter EPS was about Rs 8, and the analyst estimated annual earnings of Rs 30 to 32 on a stable model, giving a P/E of 8 to 9 times.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: Engro's book value was about Rs 266 per share, and the share price traded close to book value, which the analyst noted on 28 Apr 2026.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: The analyst expected an Engro dividend stream to start around calendar 2027, following the pattern seen at Hub Power, though this is only a possibility.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: GlaxoSmithKline Pakistan's first-quarter results showed sales growth and higher gross margins, which the analyst found encouraging after its strong fourth quarter of 2025.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: The analyst called GlaxoSmithKline Pakistan a reasonable option among pharma stocks because of its sales and margin growth, though the P/E figure he quoted was not clear.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: Pharma pricing has been liberalised over recent years, letting companies pass on cost increases and rupee depreciation to prices, which the analyst said benefited the sector.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: Bank book values fell even though first-quarter earnings were strong, at UBL and Bank of Punjab, because bond portfolios and government investments weighed on equity.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: Banks' advances-to-deposit ratio has fallen sharply, as deposits are placed in government securities rather than lent out, the analyst said.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)

fact_text: Net interest margin (NIM) is the spread between what a bank earns on advances and what it pays on deposits, and banks earn more when advances rise relative to deposits.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ENGROH Stock Analysis | GLAXO P/E Ratio & Banks Book Value 📈 | Midday Flash April 28, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-28)
